invariants.rationale: FileHandle file is required to access file properties such as extension, so it should be non-null.
file.extension() is called, so it should not return null to avoid NullPointerException.
AssetManager manager is used as a parameter in downstream loader calls, so it must be non-null.
fileName is used as an argument in downstream loader calls, requiring it to be non-null.
If parameter is provided (not null), it should be an instance of BaseTiledMapLoader.Parameters as used by all loader invocations.
